name: RepliFast
oneLiner: Low-cost AI tool that drafts and posts replies to Google Business Profile reviews for small businesses, with an autopilot mode on its Pro plan.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small teams that mainly need fast, consistent replies to Google reviews and don't need multi-platform review management, surveys or analytics suites.

updates.text: AI-powered review insights: topic extraction with sentiment and recommendations.
Google Business Profile visibility tools: a 0 to 100 Visibility Score plus AI-drafted Google Posts and profile updates (beta).
Backlog handoff: the review agent works through a pile of old reviews, posts the clearly fine ones and holds the rest for the owner.
Locations priced per unit on Starter and Pro; the Visibility workspace left beta and is included on every paid plan.

features: Connects to Google Business Profile through Google's official API; new reviews appear within minutes on paid plans, with a daily sweep as backstop
AI-drafted replies in the business's own tone, in the review's own language (50+ languages)
Brand tone, signature and house rules you can fine-tune
Batch generation to clear a backlog of unanswered reviews in one go
Autopilot posting on the Pro plan, replying within minutes of a new review
Star-rating rules, for example auto-posting 4- and 5-star replies while holding 1- to 3-star reviews for approval; 1- and 2-star replies always wait for the owner
Context check: when a critical review names a staff member or describes an incident, it pauses the reply and asks the owner for one line
Sentiment and recurring-theme analytics on reviews (weekly insights on Pro)
Visibility Pack (Pro): Google Posts and services drafted from your reviews and website
Free Google review reply generator on its website, no signup required

pricing.text: Free plan with 5 AI replies a month for 1 location. Starter: $15/month, or $12/month billed annually ($144 a year); up to 200 AI replies per location per month, you approve and post each reply. Pro: $29/month, or $19/month billed annually ($228 a year); unlimited replies, autopilot, weekly insights, Visibility Pack. Extra locations cost more on both plans (Pro: $12/month each for locations 2 to 5). Free Pro trial for 14 days or 15 posted replies per location, whichever comes first, no credit card. 14-day money-back guarantee.

notes: November 2026: replifast.com, /pricing, /changelog and /llms.txt fetched directly; pricing confirmed on the vendor's page (pricing last updated 2026-10-04 per the page). The older third-party figures (toolsurf.com $17 Starter) are superseded. Named customers are testimonials on the home page (a surf shop, a surf retailer and a plumbing business), none of them restaurants. No G2 listing found, so no rating.

company.text: Founded in 2025 by Kevin Hofmann; a product of SOULRISE LLC; describes itself as early-stage SaaS

pros: Low price: from $12 a month billed annually, with a free plan
Free Pro trial with no credit card
Low-star replies always wait for the owner, and critical reviews with specific details pause for input
Replies in the review's own language, 50+ languages
Priced per location with no location cap

cons.text: Google reviews only; reviews from other sites aren't included
Autopilot and weekly insights are Pro-only; on Starter you approve and post every reply
Starter caps AI replies at 200 per location per month
Young company: founded in 2025 and describes itself as early-stage

plans.trial: 14 days of Pro or 15 posted replies per location (up to 3 locations), whichever comes first; no credit card
